message: Campaign c-20261011-070048-d4fe starting: 5 rounds (auto, auto, auto, auto, auto).

Chaos Planner — LLM agent (groq/openai/gpt-oss-120b) chose latency_injection on payment-service: High business impact (10) on payment-service, long idle time, and latency injection not yet used this campaign, maximizing insight into critical path resilience.
GO: payment-service at 2/2 Ready, system 100% healthy. Blast radius: 2 dependent service(s) ['api-gateway', 'order-service'], ~100% of users, risk HIGH.
Injected latency_injection into payment-service: tc netem egress delay on one replica (payment-service-7745b65785-hhvxh).

Anomaly confirmed on api-gateway 15s after injection: pattern matches high latency. Isolation Forest score -0.040 (threshold +0.103), severity 0.94. Evidence: p99_latency_ms=248.03ms vs baseline 242.46ms (z=+0.2); caller_p99_ms=1010.00ms vs baseline 242.66ms (z=+21.1). Also deviating: order-service, payment-service. LSTM forecast for the next 60s: score -0.037 (still anomalous).

Root cause localised to payment-service (high latency, confidence 95%). api-gateway, order-service also deviate as callers of payment-service: its failure propagates to them. Change evidence: Pod payment-service-7745b65785-hhvxh: Unhealthy — Readiness probe failed: Get "http://10.244.0.30:8003/ready": context deadline exceeded (Client.Timeout exceeded while aw.
Confidence in traffic_reroute: 0.71 (history 0.88 over 3 attempt(s) x RCA 0.95 x blast factor 0.85). Decision: traffic_reroute on payment-service (fallback rolling_restart, confidence 0.71).
Executing traffic_reroute on payment-service.
traffic_reroute succeeded in 11.1s — quarantined payment-service-7745b65785-hhvxh (worst replica by live telemetry (p99=4789ms, next worst score 246 vs 4789)); traffic now on 2 healthy replica(s).
payment-service verified functional: 2/2 replicas Ready and 5 consecutive user-path probes OK (last 7ms).
Round teardown for payment-service: no residual fault found; autoscaler returned to declared bounds.

payment-service recovered: detected in 14.82s, mitigated in 17.33s, fully back to its normal operating band in 50.0s (target 120s — MET). Users saw 4 failed requests out of 1284 (0.3%) during the incident.

Executing hpa_scaleout on api-gateway.

Executing network_policy_rollback on order-service.
